visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: With a high school routine to maintain and an unintended vanish, how long can two very different sisters keep an invisible reality under wraps?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: When teen Cleo's school science experiment spirals out of control, the unexpected fallout leaves her popular older sister Molly completely invisible, sparking a frantic scramble to navigate everyday life.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Light, energetic fantasy-comedy with an easygoing rhythm that fits a lively movie night with family or friends.
